issues.on_page: County Treasurer Balance at October 1, 2022 $59.99; at September 30, 2023 311.71
issues.issue: County treasurer balances are printed below the statement (outside lines 1-28 and the roll-forward) and are not recorded anywhere except notes. Defensible because they are outside the fund roll-forward, but county treasurer balances are Cash and Cash Equivalents under the user's rules; a person may want them as an asset line.
